examples: Lab safety poster for BSL-2 lab, BSL comparison layout. 4 panels for BSL-1, BSL-2, BSL-3, BSL-4 with increasing hazard levels. Each panel: required PPE icons (lab coat, gloves, eye protection, respirator, full suit), facility features (BSL cabinet, negative pressure, HEPA filter), example agents. ISO 7010 biohazard symbol. Color-coded by level: green, blue, yellow, red. 4K, lab-grade safety poster.

PPE donning sequence poster, top-to-bottom 6 steps with figures: (1) Hand washing, (2) Don gown, (3) Don mask/respirator, (4) Don eye protection, (5) Don gloves (over gown cuff), (6) Final check. Each step with figure icon and short imperative instruction. Mandatory blue #2563eb for required PPE, safe green #16a34a for completed steps. 4K.

Chemical safety GHS poster, 9 GHS pictograms in 3x3 grid: explosive, flammable, oxidizer, gas under pressure, corrosive, toxic, harmful, health hazard, environment. Each pictogram with name and description. Compatibility chart below showing green/yellow/red matrix for common chemical pairs. 4K.
accuracy_tips: 使用 ISO 7010 标准安全符号；GHS 象形图标准正确；PPE 等级与 BSL 等级匹配；不虚构安全规程；应急流程符合机构 SOP；危险等级标 NFPA 704 菱形；高压/辐射/化学品标国际标准符号。
